summary: Standard staging deck is 4 x 8 ft (1.22 x 2.44 m) with legs at 16, 24 or 32 in (0.41, 0.61, 0.81 m); rated about 153 lb per sq ft, 110 to 190 lb each, decks clamp together. Uline's folding 96 x 48 in deck adjusts to 16 or 24 in and is rated 200 lb per sq ft. Rent about $150 per day for one deck. A fashion runway is a row of the same decks (commonly 4 ft wide, 8 ft per deck) at 2 ft high, with stairs and guardrails for heights over 30 in; manufacturers also sell 1.22 x 2.44 m modular decks up to 1.2 m high. Plywood-core decks must stay covered from rain. Interlocking event or dance flooring comes in 3 x 3 ft (0.91 m) panels, 3/4 in (19 mm) thick, snap together without tools; kits start at 9 x 9 ft and go to 30 x 30 ft, and a solid sub-floor is advised on soft grass. Plan ramps or edging where flooring meets the ground.
